Dock Street Asset Management Inc sold 25,739 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 193,027 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $32.39M, down from 218,766 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dock Street Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $908.91 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 15.09M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
